result.topic_en: A remark that giving ever new proofs of quadratic reciprocity is pointless, followed by the suggestion to seek functions belonging to arbitrary number fields as the exponential function belongs to the rationals and elliptic modular functions to imaginary quadratic fields.

items.english: Complex multiplication suggests asking for those functions which belong to an arbitrary number field in the same way as the exponential function belongs to the field of rational functions, and the elliptic modular functions to the imaginary quadratic number field.

items.english: The discovery of such functions would tie a new bond between number theory and function theory, to the benefit of both disciplines and of mathematical science as a whole.
